edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when reducing allowance.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
airdrop is guarded by onlyOwner, comparing _owner with _msgSender().
airdropArray is guarded by onlyOwner and calls _msgSender() as sender.
lock is owner-restricted and _msgSender() is used in the onlyOwner modifier.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender to authorize regaining ownership.
_lockTime is derived from block.timestamp, creating miner-influenceable lock timing.
unlock authorization depends on block.timestamp > _lockTime.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline and can be manipulated.
lock stores the current owner into _previousOwner before zeroing ownership.
lock writes _owner = address(0), removing the owner.
lock sets _lockTime = block.timestamp + time.
unlock restores _owner from _previousOwner.
unlock reads _previousOwner to validate the caller.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded[account] = true.
excludeFromReward snapshots the token balance into _tOwned.
addBotWallet marks an arbitrary address in botWallets.
removeBotWallet unmarks an address in botWallets.
setTaxFeePercent assigns taxFee directly into _taxFee used in fee math.
setMarketingFeePercent writes marketingFeePercent with no bounds, allowing 100% ETH diversion.
setMaxTxAmount computes maxTxAmount * 10**9 and writes _maxTxAmount.
setSwapThresholdAmount computes SwapThresholdAmount * 10**9 for the swap threshold.
setLiquidityFeePercent writes _liquidityFee used in liquidity fee math.
allowtrading flips canTrade to true, enabling public trading.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes the swap enable flag.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify, performing external calls before the token state updates.
_transfer delegates balance updates to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner transfers.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to decide fee handling.
_transfer flow depends on the contract's own balance and trading state before _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer requires sender == owner() while canTrade is false.
_tokenTransfer checks botWallets for sender and recipient.
_tokenTransfer reads _isExcludedFromFee through the takeFee flag.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth, an external router interaction.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with remaining ETH.
swapAndLiquify sends ETH to marketingWallet before the swap flag state is fully settled.
swapAndLiquify reads owner() when adding liquidity.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap router swap call.
addLiquidity performs the external payable Uniswap router call.
claimTokens transfers the whole ETH balance to marketingWallet.
claimTokens sends funds to the owner-controlled marketingWallet.
clearStuckBalance transfers the whole balance to a caller-supplied address.
claimOtherTokens transfers the entire held ERC20 balance to a caller-supplied wallet.
The router swap sends ETH back into the contract, executing receive() during the swap flow.
deliver subtracts rAmount from the caller's _rOwned.
deliver subtracts rAmount from _rTotal, mutating the reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the starting reflection supply.
_takeLiquidity adds rLiquidity to the contract's _rOwned balance.
constructor assigns the full _rTotal to _rOwned of the deployer.
constructor sets the initial reflection total.
constructor creates the Uniswap pair and stores it in uniswapV2Pair.
User-supplied maxTxAmount is scaled by 10**9 inside setMaxTxAmount.
User-supplied taxFee flows into _taxFee used in fee calculation.
User-supplied liquidityFee flows into _liquidityFee used in fee calculation.
time argument is added to block.timestamp to compute the lock period.
airdrop amount is multiplied by 10**9 before transferring.
airdropArray amounts are multiplied by 10**9 in the loop.
caller-supplied walletaddress receives the full contract ETH balance.
caller-supplied botwallet is written into botWallets.
newOwner argument is written directly into _owner.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer from transfer.
amount parameter flows into _transfer from transfer.
sender parameter flows into _transfer from transferFrom.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer from transferFrom.
amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
spender parameter flows into _approve.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer from airdrop.
newholders array indexes airdropInternal recipients.
contractTokenBalance parameter drives the swap amount in swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
_enabled parameter toggles swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
local half is computed and swapped for ETH.
local otherHalf is derived via SafeMath subtraction of half.
local initialBalance captures the contract ETH before swapping.
local newBalance is the difference of balances and is further reduced by the marketing share.
local marketingshare is computed by multiplying by marketingFeePercent and dividing by 100.
local contractTokenBalance is bottlenecked against _maxTxAmount in _transfer.
local overMinTokenBalance triggers the swap branch in _transfer.
local takeFee decides fee removal in _tokenTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient only feeds the transfer function and has no standalone security meaning.
amount only parameterizes the transfer call.
sender parameter is only meaningful within transferFrom.
recipient parameter is only meaningful within transferFrom.
amount parameter controls the allowance subtraction inside transferFrom.
spender is only used to key the allowance mapping in approve.
newOwner is written directly into the _owner state via transferOwnership.
time is consumed by lock when computing _lockTime.
walletaddress is the ETH recipient of clearStuckBalance's unsafe transfer.
botwallet is only used as the key written to the botWallets mapping.
maxTxAmount is scaled and stored into the _maxTxAmount state variable.
taxFee is validated and stored into the _taxFee state variable.
liquidityFee is stored into the _liquidityFee state variable.
recipient is only forwarded to _transfer inside the owner-only airdrop.
amount is scaled by 10**9 and forwarded inside airdrop.
newholders is only iterated by the batch airdrop loop.
amounts is only read in the batch airdrop loop.
contractTokenBalance parameter is split and swapped inside swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount is approved and passed to the router inside swapTokensForEth.
_enabled is the value written to swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
half is a transient arithmetic local of swapAndLiquify.
otherHalf is a transient arithmetic local of swapAndLiquify.
initialBalance only exists to measure ETH received during swapAndLiquify.
newBalance is an intermediate ETH amount used within swapAndLiquify.
marketingshare is the exact ETH value passed to the marketing transfer unsafe operation.
contractTokenBalance is a transient balance local of _transfer.
overMinTokenBalance only gates the swap branch inside _transfer.
takeFee controls fee removal inside _tokenTransfer.
